Kurulus gunu bulunamadi; f 1879-01-01 yil hassasiyeti BEYANLI. Bakilan: queenslandplaces.com.au (zaman asimi), qld.gov.au QHR (yanlis yonlendirme), Boulia shire timeline (robots yasagi).
